svg.title: Earth equirectangular slope proxy plate (elevation-derived)
svg.desc: Visual slope coding derived from the same World_topo_5layers.svg source as the alt layer (Dbachmann, CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL). NOT a true slope or ruggedness dataset - the 5 elevation bands are re-coloured by intensity so the highest bands read as steep (red/orange) and the lowest bands as flat (blue/green). This matches the visual intuition that high mountains tend to be steep but should not be used for quantitative grade analysis. Rely on the in-game PQS slope bake from the KSP plugin for accurate live data when available.
